evidence.author: davidism
evidence.quote: Flask _can't_ do that, it's in the server's control at that point.

evidence.author: robkooper
evidence.quote: The docs mention that headers/session need care with `stream_with_context`, but not that a disconnect can leave the context stuck on the thread — a warning there would be helpful even if the behavior itself is hard to change.

evidence.author: davidism
evidence.quote: They should be calling `close` on the iterator if it has that method.

evidence.author: davidism
evidence.quote: I've been looking into this for hours now, and as far as I can tell the problem is that something is not closing the response. Flask _can't_ do that, it's in the server's control at that point.

    "body": "This is the Flask 3.1.1 fix release, which fixes bugs but does not otherwise change behavior and should not result in breaking changes compared to the latest feature release.\r\n\r\nPyPI: https://pypi.org/project/Flask/3.1.1/\r\nChanges: https://flask.palletsprojects.com/en/stable/changes/#version-3-1-1\r\nMilestone https://github.com/pallets/flask/milestone/36?closed=1\r\n\r\n- Fix signing key selection order when key rotation is enabled via `SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS`.     "body": "This is the Flask 3.1.0 feature release. A feature release may include new features, remove previously deprecated code, add new deprecations, or introduce potentially breaking changes. We encourage everyone to upgrade, and to use a tool such as [pip-tools](https://pypi.org/project/pip-tools/) to pin all dependencies and control upgrades. Test with warnings treated as errors to be able to adapt to deprecation warnings early.\r\n\r\nPyPI: https://pypi.org/project/Flask/3.1.0/\r\nChanges: https://flask.palletsprojects.com/en/stable/changes/#version-3-1-0\r\nMilestone: https://github.com/pallets/flask/milestone/33?closed=1\r\n\r\n- Drop support for Python 3.8. #5623\r\n- Update minimum dependency versions to latest feature releases. Werkzeug >= 3.1, ItsDangerous >= 2.2, Blinker >= 1.9. #5624, #5633\r\n- Provide a configuration option to control automatic option responses. #5496\r\n- `Flask.open_resource`/`open_instance_resource` and `Blueprint.open_resource` take an `encoding` parameter to use when opening in text mode. It defaults to `utf-8`. #5504\r\n- `Request.max_content_length` can be customized per-request instead of only through the `MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH` config. Added `MAX_FORM_MEMORY_SIZE` and `MAX_FORM_PARTS` config. Added documentation about resource limits to the security page. #5625\r\n- Add support for the `Partitioned` cookie attribute (CHIPS), with the `SESSION_COOKIE_PARTITIONED` config. #5472\r\n- `-e path` takes precedence over default `.env` and `.flaskenv` files. `load_dotenv` loads default files in addition to a path unless `load_defaults=False` is passed. #5628\r\n- Support key rotation with the `SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS` config, a list of old secret keys that can still be used for unsigning. Extensions will need to add support. #5621\r\n- Fix how setting `host_matching=True` or `subdomain_matching=False` interacts with `SERVER_NAME`. Setting `SERVER_NAME` no longer restricts requests to only that domain. #5553\r\n- `Request.trusted_hosts` is checked during routing, and can be set through the `TRUSTED_HOSTS` config. #5636",

evidence.author: robkooper
evidence.quote: Request B runs under its own app context and `teardown_appcontext` fires when it finishes. Instead it silently runs under request A's leaked context, teardown never runs, and the thread stays poisoned indefinitely.

evidence.author: robkooper
evidence.quote: When a client disconnects mid-stream, the server abandons the body iterator and GC finalizes it later — often on a different thread. That cross-context pop fails (`LookupError`/`ValueError` from `ContextVar.reset`, swallowed as "Exception ignored in ..."), and the app context stays current on the worker thread.

query.question: 关于 Flask 中 `stream_with_context` 在客户端中途断开时导致应用上下文残留在工作线程上的问题（issue #6123），维护者 davidism 最终把根因归到哪里？他要求报告者向谁反馈，以及他给出的判断依据是什么（例如服务器是否应调用迭代器的 `close`）？

claims.text: FlaskClient.session_transaction 是一个上下文管理器，用于打开会话事务，以便修改测试客户端使用的会话；离开 with 块后会话被存回。
实现上，它通过临时测试请求上下文完成：先创建 test_request_context，再把 Cookie 加入该请求的 WSGI environ，然后在该上下文中调用 session_interface.open_session 打开会话。
若会话后端未打开会话（返回 None），session_transaction 抛出 RuntimeError。
在 yield 会话之后，若会话是 null session 则直接返回；否则在上下文中调用 session_interface.save_session 将会话保存到响应。
保存后，它用响应中的 Set-Cookie 头更新客户端 Cookie，并以 ctx.request.host.partition(":")[0] 作为主机名。
若客户端禁用了 Cookie（_cookies 为 None），session_transaction 抛出 TypeError。

    "body": "This is the Flask 3.1.2 fix release, which fixes bugs but does not otherwise change behavior and should not result in breaking changes compared to the latest feature release.\r\n\r\nPyPI: https://pypi.org/project/Flask/3.1.2/\r\nChanges: https://flask.palletsprojects.com/page/changes/#version-3-1-2\r\nMilestone: https://github.com/pallets/flask/milestone/38?closed=1\r\n\r\n- `stream_with_context` does not fail inside async views. #5774\r\n- When using `follow_redirects` in the test client, the final state of `session` is correct. #5786\r\n- Relax type hint for passing bytes IO to `send_file`. #5776\r\n",

    "body": "This is the Flask 3.1.1 fix release, which fixes bugs but does not otherwise change behavior and should not result in breaking changes compared to the latest feature release.\r\n\r\nPyPI: https://pypi.org/project/Flask/3.1.1/\r\nChanges: https://flask.palletsprojects.com/en/stable/changes/#version-3-1-1\r\nMilestone https://github.com/pallets/flask/milestone/36?closed=1\r\n\r\n- Fix signing key selection order when key rotation is enabled via `SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS`.     "body": "This is the Flask 3.1.0 feature release. A feature release may include new features, remove previously deprecated code, add new deprecations, or introduce potentially breaking changes. We encourage everyone to upgrade, and to use a tool such as [pip-tools](https://pypi.org/project/pip-tools/) to pin all dependencies and control upgrades. Test with warnings treated as errors to be able to adapt to deprecation warnings early.\r\n\r\nPyPI: https://pypi.org/project/Flask/3.1.0/\r\nChanges: https://flask.palletsprojects.com/en/stable/changes/#version-3-1-0\r\nMilestone: https://github.com/pallets/flask/milestone/33?closed=1\r\n\r\n- Drop support for Python 3.8. #5623\r\n- Update minimum dependency versions to latest feature releases. Werkzeug >= 3.1, ItsDangerous >= 2.2, Blinker >= 1.9. #5624, #5633\r\n- Provide a configuration option to control automatic option responses. #5496\r\n- `Flask.open_resource`/`open_instance_resource` and `Blueprint.open_resource` take an `encoding` parameter to use when opening in text mode. It defaults to `utf-8`. #5504\r\n- `Request.max_content_length` can be customized per-request instead of only through the `MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH` config. Added `MAX_FORM_MEMORY_SIZE` and `MAX_FORM_PARTS` config. Added documentation about resource limits to the security page. #5625\r\n- Add support for the `Partitioned` cookie attribute (CHIPS), with the `SESSION_COOKIE_PARTITIONED` config. #5472\r\n- `-e path` takes precedence over default `.env` and `.flaskenv` files. `load_dotenv` loads default files in addition to a path unless `load_defaults=False` is passed. #5628\r\n- Support key rotation with the `SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS` config, a list of old secret keys that can still be used for unsigning. Extensions will need to add support. #5621\r\n- Fix how setting `host_matching=True` or `subdomain_matching=False` interacts with `SERVER_NAME`. Setting `SERVER_NAME` no longer restricts requests to only that domain. #5553\r\n- `Request.trusted_hosts` is checked during routing, and can be set through the `TRUSTED_HOSTS` config. #5636",

    "body": "The Pallets team is pleased to release Flask 1.0. [Read the announcement on our blog.](https://www.palletsprojects.com/blog/flask-1-0-released/\r\n\r\nThere are over a year's worth of changes in this release. Many features have been improved or changed. [Read the changelog](http://flask.pocoo.org/docs/1.0/changelog/) to understand how your project's code will be affected.\r\n\r\n\r\nJSON Security Fix\r\n------------------\r\n\r\nFlask previously decoded incoming JSON bytes using the content type of the request. Although JSON should only be encoded as UTF-8, Flask was more lenient.         session transaction.  This can be used to modify the session that

        stored back.

        with ctx:
            sess = app.session_interface.open_session(app, ctx.request)

if sess is None:
            raise RuntimeError("Session backend did not open a session.")

yield sess
        resp = app.response_class()

        if app.session_interface.is_null_session(sess):
            return

        with ctx:
            app.session_interface.save_session(app, sess, resp)
